answer: A rename with no alias is breaking in both directions, so the next events break. Once the producer writes total_amount, any reader still selecting amount gets null or a missing column, and an explicit-column load or the registry gate may fail or pass silently with bad data. Downstream readers cannot just adapt, because they are not told in advance. The required sequence is expand-migrate-contract: (1) Expand: the producer writes both amount and total_amount until both are on 100% of events for 3 days. (2) Migrate: each listed consumer moves to total_amount and confirms it reads only the new field. (3) Backfill: upcast and reload retained history. (4) Contract: drop amount only after 30 days with no reads, shown by query logs. Upcasters cover replayed and late events.
